cohort: 266 patients undergoing elective cesarean delivery with a Pfannenstiel incision under spinal anesthesia
finding: Cathechol-O-methyl-transferase rs4860 and μ-opioid receptor rs1799971 may not contribute to chronic postsurgical pain development after cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The study examined the effects of two genetic polymorphisms on chronic postsurgical pain after elective Cesarean delivery.
